title: Pop the Pairs
statement:
In `text`, whenever **two equal letters sit next to each other**, they pop and disappear. After a pair disappears, the letters on both sides may become neighbours and can pop too. Keep going until no two equal letters are adjacent.

Return the **remaining text** (it can be empty).
constraints: text contains only lowercase letters a-z

examples.explanation: bb pops, then aa pops (they became neighbours), leaving ca.
The pair pops and nothing is left.

hints.nudge: When you read a letter, which letter does it have to be compared with?
hints.pattern: Use a stack of the letters that are still there.
hints.walkthrough: Repeatedly scanning and deleting pairs can take O(n^2). With a stack, process the letters once: if the new letter equals the letter on top of the stack, they form a pair, so pop the top and skip the new letter; otherwise push it. The stack always holds the text with all pairs seen so far already removed. At the end the stack is the answer.
